description: This header file declares functions and macros related to the speed density calculations for a vehicle's engine control system, including conversion macros, function prototypes for calculating charge temperature, air mass, and fuel, as well as initialization functions.

methods.name: getTCharge
methods.description: Calculates the charge temperature based on RPM, throttle position, coolant temperature, and air temperature.

methods.name: getCylinderAirMass
methods.description: Calculates the mass of air in the cylinder based on volumetric efficiency, manifold absolute pressure (MAP), and temperature in Kelvin.

methods.name: sdMath
methods.description: Performs calculations related to air mass and air-fuel ratio.

methods.name: setDefaultVETable
methods.description: Initializes the volumetric efficiency table with default values.

methods.name: initSpeedDensity
methods.description: Initializes the speed density calculation system.

methods.name: getSpeedDensityFuel
methods.description: Calculates the fuel amount based on manifold absolute pressure (MAP).
